name: swimmich-showcase-video
description: The demo video of README.md, made with Remotion from docs/showcase and the screen recording of Scripts/showcase.sh.

scripts.render: remotion render Showcase out/swimmich.mp4 && npm run preview
scripts.preview: mkdir -p ../media && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/swimmich.mp4 -vf "fps=12,scale=720:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer" ../media/swimmich-preview.gif && cp out/swimmich.mp4 ../media/swimmich.mp4
